SELECT day::text AS day
, SUM(upload)::text AS upload, SUM(download)::text AS download
, SUM(upload_ack)::text AS "uploadAck", SUM(download_ack)::text AS "downloadAck"
, SUM(seeding)::text AS seeding, SUM(downloading)::text AS downloading
, (AVG(loss) FILTER (WHERE loss_rank BETWEEN trim_count + 1 AND sample_count - trim_count))::text AS "averageLoss", (AVG(loss_ratio) FILTER (WHERE ratio_rank BETWEEN trim_count + 1 AND sample_count - trim_count))::text AS "lossRatio"
, SUM(loss)::text AS "totalLoss"
FROM ( SELECT user_traffic_daily.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day ORDER BY loss) AS loss_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day ORDER BY loss_ratio) AS ratio_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS sample_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY day) / 100 AS trim_count FROM user_traffic_daily WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{through} ) AS ranked
FROM user_traffic_daily WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{through}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
